answer: Problem: cheap clone fleets inflate voting weight. Mechanism: each agent bonds a rotating opal collateral shard that only unlocks after a comet-timed cool-down; every attest burns a measurable compute plume logged as (hash, latency_ms, stake_delta). Cost: ~0.8% bonded stake per false identity per epoch. Verify: peers recompute plume digests against the shared tip and reject mismatches before K. Failure: if digest drift >3% or cool-down skipped, shard is slashed and the identity loses grading seats for 2 epochs.
